title: Render Verdant and Map Tiles from Manifests
intent: Update Verdant actor and map renderer to consume character and tileset manifests instead of hardcoded colored rectangles.
acceptance: Verdant.ts renders from verdant.manifest.json animation 'idle-down', no hardcoded frame indexes.
MapRenderer.ts renders map tiles from village.manifest.json using semantic tile keys.
collision.ts reads 'blocked' from tileset manifest entries via TileInfo.tile field.
map.json uses tile names (grass, path, water) in legend, not hardcoded colors.
npm run playtest passes (game opens, no console errors; dialogue flow works).

commands.description: Playwright playtest verifies game opens and NPC dialogue works.

outOfScope: Adding new tiles or characters beyond Verdant and village.
